title: Colocate Notifications Near Orders
description:
**SITUATION:**

After an order is created, Notification Service fires SMS/email. When those Pods land on far-away nodes, queue lag shows up in dashboards. Ops wants Notification Pods to **prefer sitting on the same node as Order Processor** when possible — still soft enough that the app can schedule if orders move.

This lab colocates Notification near Order Processor with **pod affinity** (still soft). The goal is lower queue lag when possible — not a hard requirement that blocks scheduling.
**YOUR TASK:**

1. **Update** `notification-service` with **pod affinity** toward Order Processor Pods.
2. Verify Notification Pods are **Ready**.

**SPEC:**

- Deployment name: `notification-service` (do not rename)
- Replicas: keep **`2`**
- `affinity.podAffinity.preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution`:
  - weight: `100`
  - topologyKey: `kubernetes.io/hostname`
  - labelSelector: `app=order-processor`
- Ready: **2/2** Notification Pods Ready

**CONSTRAINTS:**

- Manifest: `notification-podaffinity-l27.yaml`.
- Affinity targets **Pods**, not node labels.
- Work only in your lab namespace (not `default`).

hints: Your namespace is in the lab chrome and in $LEARNER_NS — kubectl already defaults there.

problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Colocate Notifications Near Orders

Update `notification-service` with preferred pod affinity toward Pods labeled `app=order-processor` (`topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname`).

Docs: [Inter-pod affinity](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/#inter-pod-affinity-and-anti-affinity)

## Solution YAML

Save as `notification-podaffinity-l27.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: notification-service
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: notification-service
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: notification-service
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: order-processor
      containers:
        - name: notification-service
          image: rithvikreddyalkanti/notification-service:v1.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
```

## Declarative

```bash
kubectl apply -f notification-podaffinity-l27.yaml
kubectl get deploy notification-service -o yaml | grep -A30 podAffinity
kubectl get pods -l app=notification-service -o wide
```

Wait until **2/2** Notification Pods are Ready, then **Submit**.
